notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/61aa694c3734893da795b333a77bda2422945663.png
TWO WEEK SALE & MARCH 2024 UPDATE

Hey Blinders! 

Save 20% on Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition until Sunday 21st March! It's a great time to time to pick up the game as we've just released a brand new update introducing several quality-of-life improvements. These changes greatly improve the post-game experience, making it much easier to navigate the world and access the many DLC missions and challenges.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903670/Peaky_Blinders_The_Kings_Ransom_Complete_Edition/

Fast Travel

Now you can fast travel directly from the Pause Menu. If you’re in Garrison Lane, but you want to get the Gold medal in the Headshot Challenge in Pennyfields, for example, it's now much quicker to get to where you want to be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/fb776584214edd5ddfc9607caa398fe59886c18c.png
Progress Tracker in the Player Hub

Head to Rowena’s Van in the Player Hub to see your current progress on all the DLC. You can find posters for completed missions and medals displayed for shooting galleries and challenges. Keep checking back to see how much there is left to do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/63d941379cbde7492f17e3aef92d68cd272b8f7b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/1546e7b5584a5acb246f0b792bd65fdba15cef24.png
Waypoints and Highlighted Interactables

All DLC content is now clearly highlighted with visible waypoints in the sky and around blackboards. Additionally, lockboxes and keys needed to access the missions are also outlined. It should now be a breeze to find your way and get back into the post-game action!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/971349cd589374032ecbcf45dddd8887124994ea.png
Many thanks to the Peaky Blinders VR community for sharing your valuable feedback! We hope these improvements allow you to get the most out of Freeroam Mode and all it has to offer!

WIN A CUSTOM META QUEST 2

Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom, Maze Theory & POPeART have teamed up to offer you the chance to win a very special anniversary prize!

Bespoke, Custom-Made Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Meta Quest 2 Headset​

This premium skin wrap, designed exclusively for Maze Theory by renowned 3D designer, POPeART, features a gritty black-and-white design, Shelby family iconography and the iconic razor blade on top of the headset.

To enter, click here. You have until Saturday 16th March to enter this giveaway, so don't delay!

notes.title: First Update Available Now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/90c67989d0eb0db09e3f857ffa616d13a6f05d13.png

Hi Blinders. 

We wanted to let you know that a patch is now available for Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition which addresses the feedback shared at launch by members of the community. We have implemented a number of measures to improve the gameplay experience. Please note that you still may experience slight differences depending on your chosen hardware and specifications.

The team wanted to thank all our players for their patience and understanding as we worked to execute these improvements. For a summary of the changes, please see below.

Achievements:

 All achievements will now correctly activate as intended, meaning it is now possible to earn 100% completion

Graphics:

 Various improvements to lighting and textures
 Baked shadows now correctly apply to all scenes of the game

If you are still experiencing any issues, there is a beta patch available that automatically applies some performance optimisations. You can access this by opting into the beta for Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition. Continued support is available at peakysupport@emergent-entertainment.com and by joining our Discord server: discord.gg/peakyblindersvr


See you in Small Heath!
